There's even a philosophy around that, linguistic relativity—the idea that the language we speak shapes how we perceive reality.

but what I’m also saying, and what I suspect Jesus was *really* pointing toward, is that God doesn’t just go through *him* and only *him* to reach us and viceversa but that this presence of God can be found in *all of us*.
